entries.subject: A portrait of {client}
entries.body:
[i]“Readers do not want another studio handout — they want the person. Give me an afternoon with {client} and I will give you four columns above the fold.”[/i]

{sender} wants to write the big portrait. Doors like this can lift a career — held wrong, they open wounds.

choices.label: Decline — not this season
choices.outcome: A polite no. Journalists collect those the way agents collect favors.

entries.subject: The story behind {agency}
entries.body:
[i]“Everyone writes about the stars. Nobody writes about the people who build them. I want the agency piece — how {agency} really works.”[/i]

{sender} is offering the profile every rival house would kill for. Or the autopsy. That part is up to the conversation.

choices.label: Stay a rumor yourself

effects.text: You pass on the agency profile. Mystique is a currency too.

choices.outcome: Some agencies are better read between the lines. You stay between them.

entries.subject: Just a few questions
entries.body:
[i]“There is a story going around. You know the one. Before I print what I have, I thought I would give you the chance to make it better — or worse.”[/i]

{sender} is fishing, and the bait is your own nervousness. Whatever you say next becomes ink.

choices.label: Have the office say you are traveling
choices.outcome: “Traveling.” The word appears in the column, in quotation marks, doing a lot of work.

expire_effects.text: The unanswered press call becomes a paragraph with the word 'declined' in it.
